## Changed
- Updated for **Minecraft 26.3** (Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ / Fabric API 0.161.0+; NeoForge `26.3.0.7-beta`+). Requires Minecraft 26.3.

## Fixed
- **Jade no longer wipes your selected resource packs.** With Jade installed, Wireless Redstone's tooltip plugin was missing two config-screen translations; Jade flagged that on the title screen and the game responded by deselecting every resource pack, on every launch. The translations are now included.
- Ported to the 26.3 APIs: block codecs (removed from the game), the renamed piston push-reaction constants, and the 26.3 resource/data pack formats.

## Notes
- NeoForge for 26.3 is still in **beta**; this build targets `26.3.0.7-beta`.
- No world or config changes; existing transmitters, receivers, and pairings carry over.
